title: Complete Row Construction
statement: Let $l$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a Boolean input word with input-head position $p$, let $w_i$ be a Boolean word for each counter $i<l$, and let $r$ be a record word. Suppose every counter word has length at most $W$. There is a time $t\le l(3W+4)$ at which the row controller, started with field index and copier control both zero, is at field index $l$ with copier control zero; its input position, counter-tape contents and head positions agree with their initial values, and its record is $r$ followed by the stored encodings of all $l$ counter words in order.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a valid input-head position for $x$
$w$ assigns a Boolean word to each of the $l$ counter indices
each counter word has length at most $W$
replaced: For every input word, input position, counter words of length at most $W$, and record, there is a time $t \le l(3W+4)$ after which the row controller has appended the complete stored row, all $l$ self-delimiting fields in tape order, to the record, with every source counter unchanged and its head at zero.
